content.description:
What Cognite is Relentless to Achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. Our Moonshot is bold: unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works.

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

You own how Cognite manages revenue performance. Every quarter, our leaders need to know where we will land, why, and what to do about it. You run the process that answers those questions, from the global forecast to quarterly business reviews and operating reviews with theater leadership.

The theaters execute. You make the system around them better. You set the forecast methodology every theater follows, own the policies that define what counts as a booking or a churn, and make sure every review ends with clear actions and owners. Then you follow up on whether those actions improved results.

You rely on trusted data more than anyone, so you also own data integrity. You drive our revenue data models and connect them to how other commercial teams measure their work, so we understand the complete customer journey.

This is a high-visibility seat. You will work with theater Presidents, front-line managers, and leadership across Sales, Marketing, Value Delivery, and Finance.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

Run the global forecast. Own the forecast methodology and process. Work with each theater on how they forecast bookings, new logo acquisition, expansion, and at-risk churn. Call the roll-up number with evidence and flag risks early.

Make reviews drive results. Design and run QBRs and quarterly operating reviews. Decide what each review must answer, bring the analysis, and follow actions through to results.

Own the policies that define performance. Set and maintain the bookings policy, churn policy, and pipeline hygiene standards. Resolve edge cases and enforce the rules consistently across theaters.

Find where performance is leaking. Analyze win rates, slippage, cycle time, and conversion. Bring a point of view on what to change and work with the process owners to change it.

Connect the customer journey through data. Drive our revenue data models and align them with how Marketing, Value Delivery, and Finance measure their work, so every team sees the same picture from first touch to expansion.

How we measure success

Forecast accuracy by theater across the quarter

Lower slip rate on committed deals

Win rate and sales cycle improving quarter over quarter

Actions from QBRs and operating reviews closed and showing results

Commercial teams using shared definitions and data to run their business

What we are looking for

2-3 years at a top-tier consulting firm, or equivalent experience at a high-growth tech or industrial company

Systems thinking. You see how a change in one process affects five others

Cross-functional presence. You can align Revenue, Finance, and Marketing without managing their teams

Comfort with data. You turn a vague process problem into something measurable and sized

A habit of asking why a process exists and finding the evidence for a better one

Ability to turn messy inputs into a clear, decision-ready point of view under time pressure

Skill at turning ambiguous questions into reusable definitions that people and AI tools can both use

Interest in learning Salesforce, Gainsight, Clari, and Vasco, and in working with AI tools

Exposure to enterprise software, energy, or manufacturing is a plus

A snapshot of our many perks and benefits as a Cogniter

Competitive compensation

401(k) with employer matching

Competitive health, dental, vision & disability coverages for employees and all dependents

Unlimited PTO

Paid Parental Leave Program

Employee Referral Program

Why Cognite

You will work at the forefront of Industrial AI, partnering with some of the world's leading industrial organisations to solve problems that actually matter at scale — not hypothetical ones. You'll join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where curiosity and ownership are the norm, not the exception. If you want delivery work you can point to and be proud of, we'd love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.
